app.name: Tutor SG
onboarding.welcome_subtitle: Your child's personal AI tutor that works entirely on-device — private, safe, and always available.
onboarding.parent_setup_desc: Set up your parent account to manage your child's learning journey.
onboarding.kid_profile_desc: Add your child's name and school level so we can tailor the experience.
onboarding.choose_language_desc: You can change this anytime in settings.
onboarding.device_unsupported: This device does not meet the minimum requirements for Tutor SG. A device with at least 4 GB of RAM is needed.
onboarding.download_model_desc: This one-time download enables full offline use. It may take a few minutes on a slow connection.
onboarding.download_cellular_desc: Downloading the AI model over mobile data may use a lot of data ({{size}} GB). Connect to Wi-Fi or continue anyway?
onboarding.download_paused: Download paused. Tap Resume to continue.
onboarding.download_error_network: Network connection lost. Download will resume when reconnected.
onboarding.download_error_storage: Not enough free storage. Please free up space and try again.
onboarding.setup_complete_desc: Your child can now start learning with Tutor SG.
parent.pin_subtitle: Enter your 4-digit PIN to access the Parent area
parent.pin_locked: Too many attempts. Please wait 60 seconds.
parent.log_empty: No homework sessions yet. Ask your child to try the Camera feature!
parent.settings_telemetry_desc: Help us improve Tutor SG. No personal data or homework content is ever shared.
parent.settings_signout_confirm: Are you sure you want to sign out? All local data will remain on this device.
